title: OLEANDER Systems Engineering Design Development Process v1.0 — Candidate
purpose: Define an authentic Systems Engineering process for system boundary, requirements, functional/logical architecture, architecture/allocation trade decisions, interface/configuration control, integration/V&V planning, verification, validation/transition and in-use change without importing a universal V-model or taking authority from subsystem professions, R-F Integration, Knowledge, human Promotion or external approval.
scope_out: mandatory V-model/ISO 15288 lifecycle or aerospace review sequence
automatic Design KEEP or Project Promotion
authority_position: CANDIDATE R-E professional-domain process under the existing Professional Domain Process Contract. It is not Current until the existing Evolution, independent review, authorized human adoption and Current readback chain closes; Current architecture must continue to report Systems Engineering PROCESS_OPEN meanwhile.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on behavior across multiple components/domains/interfaces/configurations/states or requires systems-level requirement traceability, integration, verification or validation judgment.
responsibility_triggers: multi-subsystem outcome cannot be owned by one component/domain alone
system-level V&V or transition decision is required
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable Current ceiling across stakeholder/source authority, requirements, subsystem professional evidence, R-F interface state, configuration identity, V&V evidence, operational context, review independence and external approval governs.
not_triggered_when: the active decision is fully owned by one professional domain with no material system/interface relation
a diagram/report is requested without a systems-engineering claim

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential systems methods, requirement sources, standards, subsystem evidence, interface specifications, configuration records and V&V sources must pass the existing task/claim Operational Mount; candidate support extensions do not self-promote to Current Knowledge.
required_methods: Current OLEANDER Design Goal / Trade Study / FMEA / Simulation owners when triggered
candidate requirement-traceability/interface-coupling/physical-V&V extensions as bounded support only
source_routes: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook mechanisms as bounded reference without lifecycle/tool adoption
Current domain professional sources and applicable standards
standard_code_routes: project/jurisdiction/domain-specific standards only when applicable and Current; Systems Engineering creates no generic compliance authority
precedent_case_routes: bounded comparable systems/integration/V&V cases only with explicit transfer conditions
practice_routes: Current OLEANDER project/system practice evidence and failure/anomaly records
tool_knowledge_routes: Current Resolver-selected requirements/modeling/testing/runtime capability guidance; no fixed MBSE toolchain

open_items_allowed: unobserved future behavior and transferable lessons remain outside each bounded assessment
exit_conditions: declared question is assessed, affected Current claims reopen/reverify as needed, and any reusable lesson remains candidate-only with transfer/counterevidence boundary

controlling_authority_requirements: each material requirement/controlled variable retains its actual source/owner
R-F remains owner of interface maturity/disposition
subsystem professional owners retain technical/statutory authority
Systems Engineering coordination does not imply ownership
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Systems stages issue stage-side interface requirements; actual maturity/disposition is resolved per interface / Acceptance Contract by R-F and is never inferred from SYS stage number.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: remaining interface work is explicitly later/outside current claim
required maturity for current systems claim is met
no controlling-authority conflict/hidden in-claim blocker remains
integration_readback_requirements: two-sided native-source/configuration readback for material interfaces
actual system-level evidence where emergent behavior is in claim

native_source_of_truth_rules: native authority is claim-specific and requirement/configuration/model/interface/test/runtime/domain evidence remain separate carriers where appropriate
SysML diagram/dashboard/report/screenshot does not replace underlying authority
execution_owner_requirements: responsible Systems Engineering decision owner identified
subsystem/domain/test/validation owners identified for evidence they own
independent reviewer identity/authority resolved when required
tool_adapter_requirements: Current Skill Resolver selects suitable tools; no MBSE or requirements product is hardcoded as authority
actual_readback_requirements: material interface/configuration state read back from actual owner sources
integration/verification/validation evidence read back against exact configuration
anomaly/change/retest state read back when used

assurance.professional_review: Systems Engineering review judges requirement/architecture/interface/configuration/V&V reasoning at the declared systems claim ceiling without taking subsystem professional authority.
assurance.evidence_review: Verify source, configuration, method, acceptance criterion, as-run/readback and claim limits; verification and validation remain distinct.
technical_gates: subsystem professional gates remain with their owners
assurance.independent_review: Attack requirement ambiguity, hidden interfaces/coupling, wrong-configuration evidence, untested degraded/failure behavior, option-selection bias, verification-to-validation overclaim and stale evidence after change.
assurance.receipt_contract: professional-domain-process.v1.schema.json + current Master professional_processes[] summary; project receipt exists only for real project execution.

stale_scope_rules: mark only affected requirements/functions/allocations/interfaces/configurations/evidence stale unless dependency/coupling analysis demonstrates wider impact
upstream_impact_rules: evidence exposing a wrong/ambiguous requirement or stakeholder assumption reopens the exact upstream chain rather than silently changing acceptance
downstream_impact_rules: changed requirement/allocation/configuration/interface propagates to consuming subsystem decisions, integration plans and V&V evidence
interface_reopen_rules: material shared-variable/configuration/timing/state/ownership changes reopen affected R-F interfaces at owner-native scope
receipt_stale_rules: a project Systems Engineering receipt becomes stale only for materially affected claims; historical receipt remains immutable provenance

process_exit_conditions: applicable systems stages have bounded exit decisions
Current requirement/function/interface/configuration carriers exist for in-claim scope
required R-F interfaces meet claim-required maturity
blocking anomalies/retest/change obligations are closed or outside claim
required review is bound to exact inputs
professional receipt is Current for an actual project instance
open_items_allowed: explicit later/outside-claim items with owner, evidence ceiling and reopen trigger that do not contradict the bounded verdict
completion_contract.professional_receipt: SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_DESIGN_PROCESS_RECEIPT for real project execution only; candidate-definition validation emits no project receipt.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: If later adopted Current and actually executed, a bounded PASS may satisfy only the triggered Systems Engineering dependency; it grants neither Design KEEP, R-F Integration PASS, Project Promotion, statutory approval nor Current Knowledge.
does_not_prove: Current adoption of this candidate definition
